dedupe_keys.name: tasas de interes de captacion y operaciones del mercado monetario

description: Tasas de interés de captación y operaciones del mercado monetario. is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia - SUPERFINANCIERA, Bogotá D.C.. La información contenida en este conjunto tiene como objetivo conocer y divulgar con mayor oportunidad la estructura temporal de las tasas de interés pasivas en todos los plazos de captación a través de CDT y de CDAT, así como el volumen total captado por red de oficinas y por tesorería, la tasa interbancaria para operaciones ... Coverage: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia - SUPERFINANCIERA, Bogotá D.C.. The portal files it under the publisher Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia - SUPERFINANCIERA, Bogotá D.C.. Its tags are cdt, interes, tasas, depositos, cdat. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Hacienda y Crédito Público. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
